scope: diagnostic raw topology, not production ABI or design-eligible routing graph
encoding: little-endian u32 records without header; manifest fixes schema and SHA-256
node_identity: all tile wires grouped by native Node.getNode base identity; minimum tile-address/wire-index member is canonical

ordering.nodes.bin: ID assigned at first encountered member in sorted tile/wire enumeration
ordering.wires.bin: tile_address, wire_index; NOT grouped by node ID

node_flags.4: native instance member getter empty; members reconstructed by exhaustive wire-to-node enumeration

dictionaries.intents.csv: explicit native intent ordinal to name
dictionaries.tiles.csv: address, name, type, slr, column, row, wire_count, pip_begin, pip_count

verifier_outputs.footprint_node_map.bin: one u32 device-graph node ID per original footprint node ID
verifier_outputs.footprint_pip_map.bin: one u32 native catalog PIP ID per original footprint PIP ID; DCP reversal remains in original footprint flags

qualification: Missing endpoints, clock and route-through restrictions, capacities, delays, directed CSR and physical PIP identity in route outputs require separate qualification before routing. Never treat a raw catalog edge as implicitly legal or zero-delay.
